blueprint_concepts: Position of points wrt a line

concept_use.Position of points wrt a line: The two points are on opposite sides of L_t exactly when f(1,1) f(4,2) < 0; this sign condition is solved for t.

hindi: एक वास्तविक संख्या $t$ के लिए, माना $L_t$ रेखा $x+ty=t^2$ को दर्शाता है। माना $S$ उन सभी वास्तविक $t$ का समुच्चय है जिनके लिए बिन्दु $(1,1)$ तथा $(4,2)$ रेखा $L_t$ के विपरीत ओर स्थित हैं। तब $S$ दो असंयुक्त विवृत अन्तरालों का सम्मिलन है जिनकी कुल लम्बाई है
solution: Order: $1-\sqrt5<\dfrac{1-\sqrt5}{2}<\dfrac{1+\sqrt5}{2}<1+\sqrt5$; both factors are downward parabolas in $t$
Product $<0$ exactly where one is positive and the other negative: $S=\left(1-\sqrt5,\frac{1-\sqrt5}{2}\right)\cup\left(\frac{1+\sqrt5}{2},1+\sqrt5\right)$
solution_full: Write $f(x,y)=x+ty-t^2$. Two points lie on opposite sides of $f=0$ exactly when the values of $f$ at them have opposite signs.
$1-\sqrt5<t<\dfrac{1-\sqrt5}{2}$: first negative, second positive, product negative.
$\dfrac{1+\sqrt5}{2}<t<1+\sqrt5$: first negative, second positive, product negative.
At the four zeros one of the points lies on $L_t$, so they are excluded.
originality_note: New: the line moves with a parameter that enters quadratically (x + t y = t^2), so the side-test becomes a product of two quadratics in t whose sign chart gives two intervals (way 2: object defined by a construction, then analysed). Closest known: 'find a such that two fixed points lie on opposite sides of a line with parameter a' (linear in a). Different because: both values are quadratic in t, giving four critical values and two intervals whose lengths combine to sqrt 5.
stem_review: Read as a student: every point, line, curve and symbol is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy/mpmath (and a numerical brute-force check), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Stated that S is a union of two disjoint open intervals so that 'total length' has one meaning. Changed: No change.
key_step: Sign chart of the product of two quadratics in t built from the side test.
justification: One standard test (sign of the line expression) followed by a routine sign chart with four roots; no insight, but more than one move. Placed like the routine chains rated 2, above the single-move case split of 2021-P1-Q17 (L1).
